$comment: MCP manifest — MUST stay at the repo root (Claude Code doesn't detect it under .claude/). The CODE for custom servers lives in infra/mcp-servers/. No secrets here: tokens flow through the environment (see .env.example). S&P Global and Tavily are connectors already available on the account. ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} is a Claude-Code-specific substitution (absolute repo root); the ':-.' fallback keeps these entries launchable relative to cwd under any other MCP client.

gpu-price.$comment: Custom server — infra/mcp-servers/gpu-price-server/. Run via the repo's uv environment (no global `python` assumed): needs `mcp` + `core.storage`, both resolved from the root pyproject.toml.

sp-global.$comment: S&P Global / Kensho — institutional reference financial data. HTTP connector already available on the account; URL/auth to confirm in the console.
